definitions.gloss: illegal transaction; black market deal; underground dealing
definitions.explanation: A transaction conducted secretly and illegally, outside official or regulated channels. Includes black market sales, illicit trading, and under-the-table deals.

examples.japanese: {闇取引|やみとりひき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested for illegal transactions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闇取引|やみとりひき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Illegal arms dealing has become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食料品|しょくりょうひん}→食料品：01439_shokuryouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闇取引|やみとりひき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{横行|おうこう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In postwar Japan, black market dealing of food was rampant.

notes: Composed of ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧ (darkness, secrecy) + ⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧ (transaction, deal). The prefix ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧ is productive for illegal/underground activities: ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧ (illegal channel), ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧ (loan sharking), {闇|やみ}{市|いち} (black market). Historically associated with the postwar black market ({闇市|やみいち}). In modern usage, appears in news about organized crime, smuggling, and online illegal sales.
